dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> appears to have something on her mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Mr. Reko, do you have the gemstones my boss ordered from you a while ago?

dialogues.speaker: Reko
dialogues.text: Please don't worry, Miss Jahoda. I've found a very reliable supplier. As soon as I have the gems, I'll have them delivered straight to the Curatorium.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I appreciate your help with this. Once the gems arrive, I'll come by to help escort them.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Nothing must go wrong. Absolutely nothing must go wrong. If it does, Boss Nef will have me running errands again...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Boss Nef's going to be in a great mood once the gems get here. That'd be a great time to ask for time off, I bet.)

dialogues.speaker: Reko
dialogues.text: Ah... that would be ideal. Thank you in advance, Miss Jahoda.
